meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 它把长期任务拆成一条条极细的步骤:先登记目标和成功标准,把每步写进实时计划清单,完成一步就把可核查的证据绑定到当前代码树记下来;中断或丢上下文后从记录恢复继续,而不是重新规划。
howto.when: 当你提到 `ulw-loop`、`ulw` 等关键词,或要求目标式循环、需要带检查点的长期执行时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个任务,把目标拆成可核查的步骤。
say.note: 会先登记目标和成功标准

say.text: 继续上次的 ulw-loop,从检查点恢复,别重新规划。
给我看当前 ulw-loop 的状态和已有证据。
say.note: 输出进度和已记录的证据

howto.what_en: It splits long work into ultra-granular steps: registers the goal and success criteria first, mirrors each step into a live plan, and records observable evidence bound to the current code tree; after context loss it resumes from records.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you mention `ulw-loop`, `ulw` or ask for a goal loop, durable or checkpointed long-running execution.

say_en.text: Run this as an ulw-loop: break the goal into verifiable steps.
Resume the last ulw-loop from its checkpoint, don't re-plan.
Show me the current ulw-loop status and evidence.
